List the available Glyos palettes

Source: R/palettes.R
glyos_palette_names.Rd

List the available Glyos palettes

Usage

glyos_palette_names(company = NULL, line = NULL)

Arguments

company

Optional company name (see glyos_companies()) to restrict the list to. Matched case-insensitively and by unique prefix, so "godbeast" and "spy monkey" work.

line

Optional product line (see the line column of glyos_colorways) to restrict the list to, matched the same way.

Value

A character vector of palette names accepted by glyos_palette() and the scale_*_glyos() functions.

Examples

glyos_palette_names()
#>   [1] "standard"                    "reverse"                    
#>   [3] "spectre"                     "hades"                      
#>   [5] "infection"                   "neo_phase"
